answer: Sybil resistance comes from making each identity post a refundable stake bonded to a scarce resource, so spawning a gale of fake agents costs as much as the honest ocean of real ones. Forged identities are no free fable: an attacker wanting majority control must lock a majority of total stake, and provable misbehavior is slashed, so the cheapest attack stays pricier than any gain it could capture.
